essays.text:
英譯中：請將下列英文翻譯成中文
① The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) warns that people love to eat iceproducts in the summer, but inspections carried out in the past have oftenfound that ice products on the market fail to meet the standards. Accordingto the FDA, bacteria can be harmful to the human body, and can causeproblems with the digestive system in the less serious cases and possiblyfood poisoning in the more serious cases.（15 分）
② Real online education lets students move at their own pace and includessuch features as continual assessments so they can jump ahead as soon asthey have mastered a skill. Conceiving, designing, and developing agenuine online course or program can consume as much as a year of facultytraining and collaboration with instructional designers.（15 分）

中譯英：請將下列中文翻譯成英文
①網路已成為現代生活不可或缺的一部分，因為它使尋找和分享資訊變得非常容易，並幫助我們與別人聯繫。（15 分）
②多數民眾知道遠離二手菸害的重要，但醫師表示，三手菸隱藏在環境中，不僅跟二手菸一樣可怕，而且更容易被幼童接觸到。（15 分）
